authority_invariant: PentaCensus may discover, count, classify, diff and route Penta namespace evidence. Discovery, documentation, taxonomy placement, confidence or repeated observation never create canonical identity, execution eligibility, credentials, provider permission, certification, production status, financial or rights authority, or D3/human-reserved authority.

systems.purpose: Continuously census the governed CrownThrive Penta namespace, detect previously unseen Penta symbols and machine keys, distinguish canonical, extension, alias and candidate identities, and route unresolved discoveries into fail-closed canonicalization and documentation lanes.
systems.human_surface: Penta census summaries, namespace drift findings, discovery evidence, classification queues and reconciliation receipts
systems.authority_boundary: Read/discovery/classification only. It cannot self-register a new canonical Penta, promote maturity, grant execution eligibility, write provider state, use credentials, move money, alter rights, merge/release code, certify itself, or perform D3/human-reserved decisions.

five_stage.discover: Scan governed source classes for explicit Penta symbols and machine keys and bind each observation to source-path evidence.
five_stage.govern: Compare observations to canonical registry, governed extensions, aliases and candidate namespace records without promoting unresolved discoveries.
five_stage.execute: Produce deterministic census and drift results and route unknown identities to PentaScribe/PentaPology/PentaDocs canonicalization lanes.
five_stage.verify: Require deterministic replay, namespace-count consistency, exact-source evidence and independent PentaAssure/PentaCertify evidence before any maturity promotion.
five_stage.preserve: Retain namespace lineage and candidate dispositions so renames, aliases, supersessions and historical references are not erased.

production_promotion_requirements: Penta Portal Docs regeneration is converged
